actuator.meaning: Selects the legacy Backblaze configuration operation. A top-level actuator takes precedence over the payload member.

metadata.meaning: Exactly these five initial configuration fields. A top-level metadata member takes precedence over this payload member.

keyId.meaning: Backblaze account key ID. Keyman intake accepts at most 511 UTF-8 bytes and excludes NUL, LF, CR and double quote.

applicationKey.meaning: Backblaze application key. Keyman intake accepts at most 511 UTF-8 bytes and excludes NUL, LF, CR and double quote.

bucket.meaning: Bucket name. Replacing hyphens with underscores must leave an ASCII Keyman service name.

prefix.meaning: Repository prefix; null leaves the prefix out of the saved configuration.

paths.meaning: Nonempty list of absolute source paths, without NUL.

locked.meaning: The configuration was saved and locked.

keyman_service.meaning: Keyman service name derived from the bucket.

mutationPerformed.meaning: The helper reports true after writing the configuration and false on a refusal; a late refusal does not prove that no prior Keyman act occurred.

reason.meaning: Refusal diagnostic, not firstMissingSignal. It can contain configuration I/O diagnostics, remote verification text, or a Keyman signal.
examples: payload fields must be keyId, applicationKey, bucket, prefix, and paths
configuration is locked after initial setup
